reviews.review: Literally anyone with a brain can figure out than a 0.06% drop rate is bad game design.

Pros
-no gameplay mechanic is hidden behind a paywall, everything that you need to get new warframes, weapons and mods are available in game for free.

-almost every area in the game is accessible, little to no "invisible walls" to stop you, for the most part, if you can see it you can get to it.

-decent variety of maps, uses randomly generated maps with set tilesets, not always completely different but varied enough to be not boring.

- Developers regularly take in player feedback and adjust the game accordingly

-huge variety of weapons of which most are viable to use even all the way to the end game. naturally there are some weapons that the community deems the best, but very few can be considered "useless"

Cons

- If you are not willing to spend money on the game's in-game currency (platinum), then build times for the warframes and weapons can feel like they take a long time (warframe parts take 12hrs to complete by themselves and the warframe itself will take 72hrs, meaning building one warframe will take at least 3 and a half days, weapons take 24 hours to complete). this can be mitigated through in-game trading as platinum is tradable between players.

- The game is not new player friendly, there is a simple tutorial on the basic controls of the game (does not include things such as sliding, bullet jumping, wall climbing/grabbing) and does not explain the mod system (i.e. the most important system in the game) to the player at any point in time.

- The game has its fair share of bugs that occur frequently enough to be aware of them, but not enough to be game breaking.

- Trading system is very poorly put together, if it weren't for 3rd party sites, trading in the game would basically be dead.


Overall score 8.5/10

Beautiful game! Adore the streamline/smooth movement. I feel like I am part of the game. Totally unique from other games in that aspect! When I thought about it being free to play I just lost it! SO COOL! The community is soooo friendly and everyone I know who has picked up this game just can't put it back down! I really can't write a review worthy of this game. GET IT! Try it now!

All items attainable through a little bit of grind, steep learning curve, mostly helpful community, and the most supportive game devs on the market. Look no further if you're that player looking for the absolute best replacement for Destiny.
